description: Checks whether a public page can be indexed by search and AI engines once a crawler reaches it. Measures HTTP status and redirects, noindex, canonical target, how much copy exists in the raw HTML without JavaScript, client-side rendering signals, title and H1, XML sitemap coverage, response time, HTML size, structured data validity, dates and language. Use for "why is this page not showing up in ChatGPT or Perplexity?", "is this page indexable?" or to check a JavaScript-rendered page. It does not query any index.

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the page to check, for example https://example.com/pricing.

name: check_ai_indexability
title: Check AI indexability of a URL
